chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Sayf ibn Ameyra, from Sa'd ibn Tareyf, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The one who enshrouds a believer is like the one who guarantees his clothing until the Day of Resurrection.

key_terms.كَفَّنَ: to enshroud (prepare a body for burial)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for enshrouding a believer?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to emphasize the immense spiritual merit of performing the physical act of kafan (enshrouding) for a deceased believer. The analogy of guaranteeing clothing signifies that just as one ensures the deceased's dignity in the grave, the performer is spiritually 'guaranteed' their own provision and covering until the Day of Judgment, reflecting the Shia emphasis on communal care and bodily respect in death.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from Sa’ad Bin Tareyf, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who enshrouds a Believer would be like the one guarantees his dress up to the Day of Judgement’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Sayf ibn ‘Amirah from Sa‘d ibn Tarif who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
One who provides shrouding (materials) for a believing person is like one whose dressing (needs) is guaranteed up to the Day of Judgment.’”
